Founded in 1994, as a [[superstructure]] on [[Horsens fS]] (founded 1915), [[Stensballe IK]] and [[FC Horsens]], the club competes in the [[Danish Superliga]] following promotion in 2025-2026 from the [[Danish 1st Division|1st Division]], the second tier of the [[Danish football league system]]. Both [[Stensballe IK]] and [[FC Horsens]] has later left the cooperation, and only [[Horsens fS]] remains."}}
